title: The Dataloader Choke Point
name: dataloader-choke-point
review_notes: Reviewed canonical rendered artwork and source. Retains original canonical plot rather than redrawing source data. Worker cursor and explicitly qualitative single-batch readiness trace; no invented rates or timings.
static_reason: The current cursor and readiness cards narrate an existing curve without modeling queue occupancy, overlap, or starvation. Retain the static plot until an actual queue model earns an interaction.

title: Sliding-window convolution
name: convolution
learning_value: A shared filter moves across input positions; each window produces actual products, partial sums, and one completed output. Overlapping windows reveal reuse.
review_notes: Canonical 7×7 input, orange 3×3 window, and violet 5×5 output preserved in an explicitly declared single-channel valid cross-correlation example. Independent arithmetic, all 35 states in four actual-chapter profiles, 25 output values, 225 MACs, and 25 writes verified. Full playback, compact layout, narrow menu, and reduced-motion/static fallbacks checked. Counts describe logical scalar work, not measured memory transactions.

title: Quantized arithmetic, value by value
name: quantized-matmul
learning_value: Values change from floating operands to quantized INT8, corrected INT32 products and sums, then a requantized output. Changing scale reveals rounding error and representation costs.
review_notes: Canonical INT8 → integer compute → INT32 → requantized output pipeline preserved in a declared 1×3 by 3×1 numerical example. Independent checks verified all eight stages in four actual-chapter profiles and both activation scales: accumulators 84/163 reconstruct to 0.42/0.4. Zero-point correction, rounding, error, and operand storage accounting checked. No measured speedup or total-memory claim.
